findings.officialCurrentTariff: From 2026-09-01 the official Städtische Werke tariff page/press release states 0.49 EUR/kWh AC and 0.59 EUR/kWh DC for Ladenetz customers, with 0.09 EUR/min idle fee after 120 min AC / 60 min DC and no idle fee 22:00-06:00. For users outside Ladenetz it states 0.53 EUR/kWh AC or 0.65 EUR/kWh DC plus 4 EUR start fee.
findings.adHocConflict: An official station announcement for Frankfurter Straße explicitly states QR ad-hoc at 0.59 EUR/kWh AC while the Städtische-Werke card price there is 0.53 EUR/kWh. This is not safely equivalent to the generic outside-Ladenetz matrix, so no network-wide ad-hoc fallback is created.
findings.prefixEvidence: BNetzA/Mobilithek-derived station records show EVSEs such as DE*KSL*E005007 and normalized DEKSLE003401 / DEKSLE005601, consistent with DE*KSL.

cpos.blockingReason: Official sources expose conflicting channel/scope semantics for direct charging (generic non-Ladenetz matrix versus station-specific QR ad-hoc price). Exact station/EVSE prices can be used where directly evidenced, but no universal ad-hoc rule is safe yet.
cpos.neededToComplete: Authoritative direct-payment/QR tariff matrix or checkout evidence that explicitly defines whether the generic non-Ladenetz tariff applies to all DE*KSL ad-hoc sessions, including exceptions.

findings.officialAccess: The official Stadtwerke Heidelberg app pages confirm that their own stations can be selected, started and paid through the fuer dich / heidelbergEMOBIL ecosystem; chargecloud is the app technology provider.
findings.stationLevelOpenData: BNetzA/Mobilithek-derived records confirm operator ownership and EVSEs such as DE*1HD*ESWH29*001/002 and DE*1HD*ESWH85*001/002, with credit-card/NFC and app/RFID payment capabilities.
findings.pricing: No authoritative current 2026 universal direct-payment/QR price matrix was found. Third-party discovery sources suggest station-level prices around 0.36 EUR/kWh and an App Store review mentions 0.475 EUR/kWh plus a time fee, but neither is authoritative enough for ingestion.

cpos.blockingReason: Operator and EVSE namespace are authoritative, but current ad-hoc/direct tariff values are not published in a sufficiently authoritative station-level or network-level source accessible without login.
cpos.neededToComplete: Public QR checkout/direct-payment response, official tariff document, or authoritative chargecloud endpoint exposing current price components per DE*1HD EVSE.

guardrails: No third-party or user-review price is ingested as authoritative.
No tariff is generalized beyond the source scope.
Previously deferred CPOs were not re-audited in this pass.
